text: On July 19, 20, 21, and 22, 2022, City Council approved an application for a zoning by-law amendment at 5 Sewells Road and 182 to 250 Brenyon Way to facilitate the development of two 9-storey rental apartment buildings with affordable housing. The applicant is currently at the site plan application stage of the development process. A requirement in the notice of site plan approval conditions is the conveyance of a road widening along the development site. The proposed road widening is separated from the development site by a reserve (or strip of land originally conveyed to the City through a historic subdivision approval). Because this reserve does not form part of the existing public highway and separates the development site from the existing public highway, it prevents the City’s acquisition of the road widening under site plan approval authority. City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend its decision on item 2022.SC33.12 by adding the following: 8. City Council dedicate as a public highway certain lands along the southerly limit of Sewell Road and the westerly limit of Brenyon Way, shown as Parts of Blocks L and N on Registered Plan 66M-1607, for public highway purposes. 9. City Council authorize and direct the appropriate City Officials to take the necessary action to give effect to City Council's decision, including the introduction in Council of any Bills that may be required.
